newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Novartis raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Novartis raised to buy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has raised its rating for Novartis AG to buy from sell.
-- "The strong appreciation of ths Swiss franc ... is likely to continue and we expect this to benefit earnings," analyst Chris Spooner wrote in a Feb 18 report.
-- "Although our year-end 1997 price target for the (American Depositary Receipts) is a modest $65, we think this may be conservative.
-- "We believe Novartis ADRs are a solid long-term investment, as we project the company will consistently add to value through 2002."
-- The company's ADRs closed on Tuesday at 60-1/8 in New York.
